publishedRecipe.name: Creamy Dill Chickpea Salad Sandwich with Strawberries

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spring mix if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch fresh dill
2 medium carrots
2 tomatoes
1 (5 oz) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)
1 (16 oz) pkg strawberries

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse the chickpeas; transfer to a medium bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Add mayo, Dijon, vinegar, and spices to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
2 tsp Dijon mustard
2 tsp apple cider vinegar
¼ tsp onion powder
¼ tsp paprika
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Use a fork or potato masher to crush the chickpeas, making a semi-smooth spread. Set aside.
Peel, trim, and julienne or coarsely grate the carrots.
Place bread slices on a flat surface. Spread half of the slices with a thick layer of chickpea salad and top carrots, tomato, and spring mix. Cover sandwiches with remaining bread slices.
To serve, divide sandwiches and strawberries between plates and enjoy!
